subject: Baron Geddon (encounter 50668) guidance and encounter-fact sources for Paladin Holy HPS

retrieval.method: Automated page fetch by the implementing agent; excerpts below were returned verbatim by that fetch.
retrieval.independent_reviewer_fetch: The reviewing agent's own fetch of the same page returned HTTP 403, so it did not independently re-read the live page; it reviewed these excerpts and the rule sentences.

excerpts.ignite_mana_ability: Burns 400 mana from nearby enemies every 3 sec. for 5 min.
excerpts.ignite_mana_damage: Each point of mana that is destroyed also damages the target from which it is consumed.
excerpts.ignite_mana_dispel: Ignite mana should be dispelled, but not from warriors or rogues.
excerpts.ignite_mana_range: keeping healers and the dispellers out of Ignite Mana's range saves on mana used dispelling
excerpts.living_bomb_ability: After 8 sec., the bomb explodes, inflicting 3200 Fire damage to the target and its nearby allies.
excerpts.living_bomb_strategy: Whoever is the living bomb MUST run away from the group and blow up by himself.
excerpts.inferno_ability: Surrounds the caster with an inferno that periodically inflicts Fire damage to nearby enemies for 8 sec.
excerpts.inferno_strategy: When Baron Geddon starts his inferno all melee DPS needs to leave, even the MT.
excerpts.healer_position: another group directly behind them that is out of the range of the Baron's Ignite Mana but still within healing range.

sources.excluded: Season of Mastery notes (three Living Bomb targets, fire patches) are not Classic Era behavior and support no rule.

sources.status: no strategy content: two fetches on 2026-10-19 returned only site navigation and boilerplate

loadout_boundary: The page gives no healer gear or loadout guidance; its only resistance mention concerns the bomb or main-tank context. The loadout rule therefore records a limitation of the cited source, not evidence that healer gearing cannot matter.
